assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent dizziness consistent with a history of atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a concurrent diagnosis of mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with arrhythmic events and assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
The service addresses the specific clinical need to evaluate the patient's condition as described in the indication note.
